title: 第 十一章 铜片第 十二章 周家
slug: 残鼎复元陆家修仙崛起路
content_zh:
陆行舟一会儿看看，一会儿瞧瞧那。
这摆摊区实在太大，他逛了一个多小时，才逛了一半。
这时，陆行舟才猛地想起自己来这儿是要做什么。
于是，他找到摆摊区的管理人员，交了一块灵石的摊位费。
随后，摆好一张桌子，将三种丹药整齐地摆放上去。
然而，这里的丹药并不像在青云坊市那样好卖。
他摆了两个时辰，凝气丹倒是全部卖完了，可辟谷丹和清灵散却只卖出两瓶。
同时，陆行舟还留意到，在流云仙城活动的人，大多都是炼气中期以上的修为。
炼气初期的，除了那些商铺的店小二，几乎见不到。
他无奈的收了摊位，准备去购买些炼制凝气丹的材料。
当陆行舟朝着售卖灵药的摊位走去时，路过一个售卖法器的摊位，不由自主地停了下来。
摊位上不仅摆放着各式法器，还有各种不知名的碎片。
陆行舟之所以停下脚步，是因为他布袋中的溯原鼎在微微颤动。
而且似乎有种想要挣脱束缚冲出来的冲动。
这让陆行舟大为不解，自他得到这个鼎以来，从未发生过这种情况。
陆行舟思索片刻，觉得唯一的可能就是，这个摊位上有什么东西吸引着溯原鼎。
陆行舟一只手紧紧按住布袋中的溯原鼎，佯装挑选法器，缓缓蹲了下来。
摊主是一位炼气后期的中年男子，见陆行舟对自己的法器感兴趣，立刻热情地介绍起来。
“这位道友，我这些可都是天兵门的大师亲手炼制的，在这片区域，绝对没有谁家的法器能比我的更好……”
“道友，你既然卖法器，怎么这儿还摆着这些碎片呀？”

陆行舟看了一会儿法器后，佯装不经意的开始查看那些碎片。
“唉！说起来就晦气。”
中年男子无奈地叹了口气。
“之前我和同伴一起去流云山脉探险，发现了一个洞府，本以为能发一笔横财。”
“没想到进去之后，里面啥都没有，就只剩一地这种碎片。”
“想着来都来了，好歹也是古修士的洞府，就捡了一些，看看能不能卖点灵石。”
陆行舟此刻根本没心思听男子在说什么。
他的目光，完全被手中一块小小的铜片吸引住了。
当这块铜片落在他手中时，布袋中的溯原鼎颤动得愈发剧烈。
陆行舟极力的压制着溯原鼎想要挣脱而出的冲动。
他心里清楚，这块铜片对溯原鼎而言必定重要，无论如何都得设法将其弄到手。
他担心自己控制不住溯原鼎，一旦让它冲出来，那可就麻烦大了。
“道友，你这件下品防御法器怎么卖？”陆行舟开口问道。
他心里盘算着，如果单独提出购买这铜片，如此举动实在太过惹人怀疑。
他怕那男子察觉到异样，进而拒绝卖给他，所以只能先从法器入手。
“道友真识货，这件防御法器在我整个摊位上，算得上是精品……五十五块灵石。”
男子滔滔不绝地介绍着。
“不行，太贵了，最多四十五块。”
陆行舟果断还价。
“这个价格卖不了，最低五十。”

男子态度坚决。
content_en:
Lu Xingzhou looked at it for a while, then looked at it for a while.
The stall area was so big that it took him more than an hour to visit only half of it.
At this moment, Lu Xingzhou suddenly remembered what he was here to do.
So, he went to the manager of the stall area and paid the stall fee for a spiritual stone.
Then, a table was set up and the three elixirs were placed neatly on it.
However, the elixirs here are not as easy to sell as in Qingyunfang City.
He displayed it for two hours, but all the Qi Condensing Pills were sold out, but only two bottles of Bigu Pill and Qingling Powder were sold.
At the same time, Lu Xingzhou also noticed that most of the people active in Liuyun Immortal City were in the middle stage of Qi Refining or above.
In the early stage of Qi refining, except for the waiters in those shops, you can hardly see them.
He reluctantly closed the stall and prepared to buy some materials for refining the Qi Condensing Pill.
When Lu Xingzhou was walking towards the stall selling elixirs, he passed by a stall selling magic weapons and stopped involuntarily.
The stalls were not only filled with various magical instruments, but also various unknown fragments.
Lu Xingzhou stopped because the Suiyuan Cauldron in his bag was trembling slightly.
And there seems to be an urge to break free and rush out.
This puzzled Lu Xingzhou. This had never happened since he obtained the tripod.
Lu Xingzhou thought for a moment and felt that the only possibility was that there was something in this stall that attracted Suyuan Ding.
Lu Xingzhou held the Suyuan Cauldron in the bag tightly with one hand, pretended to select a magical weapon, and slowly squatted down.
The stall owner was a middle-aged man in the late stage of Qi refining. Seeing that Lu Xingzhou was interested in his magical weapon, he immediately introduced it enthusiastically.
"Fellow Taoist, these are all made by the masters of the Heavenly Weapon Sect. In this area, there is absolutely no one whose magic weapon is better than mine..."
"Fellow Taoist, since you sell magic weapons, why are these fragments still displayed here?"
After Lu Xingzhou looked at the magical artifact for a while, he pretended to look at the fragments casually.
"Alas! That sounds unlucky."
The middle-aged man sighed helplessly.
"My companions and I went on an expedition to the Liuyun Mountains before and discovered a cave. I thought we could make a fortune."
"I didn't expect that after I went in, there was nothing inside, just debris like this on the ground."
"I thought that since I came here, it is also the cave of ancient monks, so I picked up some to see if I could sell some spiritual stones."
Lu Xingzhou had no intention of listening to what the man was saying at the moment.
His eyes were completely attracted by a small piece of copper in his hand.
When the piece of copper fell into his hand, the Suyuan Cauldron in the cloth bag trembled more violently.
Lu Xingzhou tried his best to suppress Suyuan Ding's urge to break free.
He knew in his heart that this piece of copper must be important to Suyuan Ding, and he had to try to get it no matter what.
He was worried that he wouldn't be able to control the Suyuan Cauldron, and if he let it rush out, he would be in big trouble.
"Fellow Taoist, how do you sell this low-grade defensive weapon of yours?" Lu Xingzhou asked.
He thought that if he proposed to buy the copper piece alone, such an action would be too suspicious.
He was afraid that the man would notice something strange and refuse to sell it to him, so he could only start with the magic weapon first.
"Fellow Taoist, you really know the goods. This defensive magic weapon in my entire stall can be regarded as a fine product... fifty-five spiritual stones."
The man introduced eloquently.
"No, it's too expensive, forty-five yuan at most."
Lu Xingzhou made a decisive counteroffer.
"You can't sell it at this price, the minimum is fifty."
The man was determined.
